# Friends of Amateur Rocketry, Inc.

> > Friends of Amateur Rocketry (FAR) provides test facilities, launch infrastructure, and safety protocols for amateur rocket development in California's Mojave Desert.

FAR operates the FAR Site, a licensed rocket testing facility with launch rails, static test stands, and pyrotechnic operations permits. The organization supports amateur rocketry projects from student competitions like the FAR-Mars Launch Contest to advanced bipropellant and hybrid motor development, maintaining compliance with BATFE, California State Fire Marshal, FAA, and BLM regulations.

## Key Topics

- FAR Site facility
- Amateur rocketry testing
- Pyrotechnic operations
- Launch equipment (T-Rails, Button-Rails)
- Rocket safety protocols
- BLEVE hazards
- BATFE and CSFM regulations
- Static test stands
- FAR-Mars Launch Contest
- Membership and facility access
- Bipropellant and hybrid rockets
- Fire protection requirements
- FAA and BLM permits
- Newman Propulsion equipment

## Getting Started

- [Membership](https://friendsofamateurrocketry.org/membership): FAR membership benefits, fees, and FAR Site facility access details
- [Fees](https://friendsofamateurrocketry.org/fees): FAR Site usage pricing, membership fees, and facility rental rates
- [Contact Us](https://friendsofamateurrocketry.org/contact): Contact form for FAR directors and pyrotechnic operators
- [History](https://friendsofamateurrocketry.org/history): FAR origins: Dan Ruttle, Genesis rocket, Mojave test area development
- [Officers](https://friendsofamateurrocketry.org/officers): FAR leadership including John Newman and pyrotechnic operators

## Safety and Regulations

- [Safety](https://friendsofamateurrocketry.org/safety): Safety protocols for rocket testing per BATFE & CA Fire Marshal regs
- [Are Rockets Safe?](https://friendsofamateurrocketry.org/are-rockets-safe): Rocket safety guide covering bipropellant, hybrid, and BLEVE hazards
- [BLEVE Danger](https://friendsofamateurrocketry.org/bleve-danger): BLEVE hazard education: liquefied gas container failure risks
- [Licenses](https://friendsofamateurrocketry.org/licenses): FAA, BLM, and Kern County permits for rocket operations & classifications

## Launch and Test Equipment

- [Launchers](https://friendsofamateurrocketry.org/launchers): Launch equipment catalog: T-Rails (Baxter, Microcosm, Foster) & racks
- [Static Stands](https://friendsofamateurrocketry.org/static-stands): Motor test stand catalog: horizontal, vertical, I-beam & tilt-up stands

## Programs and Events

- [FAR-Mars Launch Contest](https://friendsofamateurrocketry.org/far-mars-launch-contest): Student competition: methane-oxygen rockets to 45,000 ft with Mars Society

## Resources and Community

- [Resources](https://friendsofamateurrocketry.org/resources): Rocketry suppliers: Estes, Apogee, components, motors & electronics
- [Volunteers](https://friendsofamateurrocketry.org/volunteers): Volunteer opportunities: STEM mentoring, facility maintenance, launches
- [Videos](https://friendsofamateurrocketry.org/videos): Rocket test videos: Sugar Shot to Space, DoubleSShot, motor tests
- [Submit Photos](https://friendsofamateurrocketry.org/submit-photos): Upload photos/videos to FAR gallery via SmugMug and YouTube
